problem: Resource cost, credits, compute, data movement and sustainability were present in delivery guidance but were not enforced as one explicit canonical invariant across every chat, agent, skill, workflow and connector.
root_cause: Resource governance was distributed across general cost/performance guidance and platform-specific behavior instead of one canonical ONE BRAIN governor with common preflight, postflight, evidence and learning requirements.
prevention: RESOURCE_PREFLIGHT_REQUIRED: material work identifies affected platforms, known quota/budget state and expected marginal resource use before expensive execution.
REUSE_BEFORE_SPEND: prefer reuse, cache/readback, dedupe, batching and incremental processing before new external work.
implementation: Expand config/brain-cost-policy.json to schema v2 as the canonical resource and sustainability authority.
Make the governor mandatory in AGENTS.md read order and ONE BRAIN contract.
Track platform meters for Supabase, Netlify, Notion, GitHub, Composio, OpenArt and Placid.
Block promotion for resource regressions without verified outcome gain.
